value.FAIL: Any preregistered threshold fails. Preserve C7D03 and delimit reprogramming or damage dependence without refitting.
value.INCONCLUSIVE: Kernel/lock mismatch, missing cases or occupied planned ports prevents adjudication.
value.PASS: Promote MATTER_REPROGRAMMING_FOUND for the lineage/response quotient and NO_REPAIR_IN_TESTED_CLASS for delayed routing, load and support repair. Do not promote autonomous adaptation, general self-repair, strict microidentity or physical matter equivalence.

domain.sector: semantic-1 normal carrier lineage in otherwise blank periodic cubic worlds; sums below cap

value.falsifier: A positive case misses the updated function, an absent/off-path/ablated control reproduces it, an intermediate reducer record is wrong, or delayed generic repair restores a class frozen as non-repairable.
value.hypothesis: A learned semantic-1 carrier lineage can be monotonically reprogrammed by an ordinary positive-load interaction and retain the updated response repertoire after redirection, while raw state and clock are nuisance variables in this apparatus. In the same tested class, delayed generic direction scaffolds do not repair direction-zero damage and cannot reconstruct erased s_reg or destroyed support.

model/rule.damage: state/clock nuisance preserves response; direction-zero, load erasure and support erasure destroy the planned response; delayed zero-load scaffold contains no learned scalar
model/rule.identity: lineage and response-repertoire quotient, not raw equality or indivisible particle identity
model/rule.update: B+delta -> B+delta+u under ordinary collision with programmer s_reg=u

nulls: The query or decoder already contains the update.
The programmer need not intersect the learned lineage.
Raw state or clock, rather than s_reg plus routing, carries the tested response.
A generic delayed routing scaffold reconstructs missing learned load or destroyed support.

observable.mechanism: exact trained, programmed and redirected intermediate records
observable.repair: response after delayed generic zero-load direction scaffold following direction/load/support damage

value.preparation: Ordinary cue+teacher collision writes B+delta. A later positive-load programmer collides with that lineage, changing it to B+delta+update and redirecting it. A zero-load carrier redirects it back to its original travel direction. Unseen queries use the fixed decoder s_reg-B. Damage controls intervene only after successful reprogramming.
value.seed/data split: All sizes, frames, deltas, updates, queries and seeds are new relative to C7D03 and frozen before execution.
